title: Kwonde Duto Motelona
stanzas: Kwonde duto motelona, Anadhi nikech agene; Aparo kaka nothona, Rembe nochwer e Kalwari.
An amor kawinjo chikne; Amor chutho kotelona;To chunya mor kuom dwarone, Kaparo thone Kalwari.
Adhiyo nyime mak aluor, Amor kuom Kristo, Jawarna;Ageno neno Osiepna, Yesu mothona Kalwari.
chorus: Yesu notelna pile ka, Yesu notelna yo duto; En e Osiep mageno chuth; En nothona e Kalwari.
